title: The *Declared* Intent
dek: Nine governments signed the AI supply chain declaration. California's kill-switch deadline passed. Geneva opened with its text already gutted.

stories.short: Nine allies sign Pax Silica text
stories.label: Pax Silica member countries protecting AI supply chains
stories.headline: The declaration never names China; the enforcement mechanism is politics.

stories.short: CCW opens with gutted draft text
stories.headline: Human oversight language was stripped in September. The conference decides whether to negotiate.
The deliverable is recommendations, not a law.

stories.label: raised by Nidus for foundation robotics models in US defense manufacturing
stories.headline: The bet: make existing factory robots learn new tasks without replacing the hardware.

stories.short: AMD Zen 6 ships in Azure, Oracle
stories.label: cores in AMD's first 2nm server CPU now shipping in production cloud systems
stories.headline: The 4nm-to-2nm jump is the largest process node advance in EPYC history.

stories.label: SK Hynix pledge to Korean chip suppliers over five years
stories.headline: The world's leading HBM supplier is building resilience into its own supply chain.

stories.label: top of Anthropic's IPO price range, pricing Tuesday on Nasdaq as ANT
stories.headline: Microsoft Ignite opens tomorrow; Anthropic prices its IPO on November 18.

still_signal: Every governance text this week describes a future instrument. AMD Zen 6 is shipping in production. Nidus is in defense factories. The gap is measurable in processor generations.
